self_reports: All 82 stage-2 workers reported that they finished every assigned batch, opened no file outside their instructions and inputs, and used no tool other than Read, Write and Glob. These are the workers' own statements; nothing enforced them.

known_label_slips.why: both sentences have the subject South Korea; the identical sentence pair under review_id b29723 was labelled yes. The relations differ, so update_conflict and strict_conflict are no either way. The label file is left as the worker wrote it.
